This rules out many in-space applications where gas pressurized feed systems are the norm, the static pressure is too low. An alternative approach is to design a heat exchanger to transfer the heat from the wall of the combustion chamber to propellant indirectly. This has the advantage of allowing the design of specified cooling rates independent of the geometryor propellant feed conditions.
